# The Event Circuit

> A music collective in Gurugram hosting intimate Saturday jam sessions and live shows.

The Event Circuit brings together singers, guitarists, and listeners for small-room jams and ticketed shows in Gurugram. RSVP is open to anyone; enquiries go over WhatsApp or email (theventcircuit@gmail.com).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Hero, about, team, how it works, upcoming sessions, highlights, FAQ, and the RSVP form.

## Optional

- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/theeventcircuit): Photos and clips from past sessions.
